claim: The cleanest mispricing in the frozen packet is the Canadian policy path: 2027 CORRA embeds a substantial hiking cycle that is difficult to reconcile with weak labor and near-target core inflation.

competing_explanations.statement: The main opposing case is energy pass-through and a global tightening regime

falsifiers.statement: The thesis fails if the BoC actually validates the priced hiking cycle through stronger core inflation, labor/wage reacceleration, or delivered/explicitly signaled tightening consistent with mid-3% 2027 CORRA.
